question: What is the prescribed width of the waist-band in this rite?
premises: The width would be that measure.
inference: The waist-band's width is fixed at half-less-kriti-matra.
uncertainties: Exact numerical value of kṛti-mātrā is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The width of the waist-band would be half-less-kriti-matra.
